title: MYC level versus MYC occupancy at early-neuron genes across the knockout, SCAR12-class and corrected organoid lines: a readout that separates a MYC driver from a disengaged MYC level (cross-line contrast, no compound)
source: harness-engineering (plan), DREAM-2 pass 2026-11-08; disease-models/wwox/research/dream2_20261108/ (README); built from rows already in disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/nb1_myc_20261107/output/evidence.tsv: E03 (SCAR12-class line, MYC-positive fraction up with a wild-type-like radial-glia fraction), E80 (MYC ChIP-seq in knockout neural stem cells: binding at early-postmitotic-neuron gene promoters lost while MYC protein is high; independent auditor's reading of one figure, not receipted) and E06 (POU5F1 as prominent as MYC); PMID 42397075 (complete read FTR-20260810-42397075-04 for the paper, rows E80-E83 not read by the producer)
causal_statement: IPOTESI: investigation INV-17 asks whether the MYC rise is a driver, a marker or a consequence; the three rows above add a fourth reading, that the MYC level is high but disengaged at neuronal targets, in which case the composition phenotype should track MYC occupancy at early-neuron genes and not MYC level, and the SCAR12-class line (MYC up, composition wild-type-like) should keep that occupancy while the knockout loses it; the combination across lines is new, each row was already in the module and the occupancy datum exists for the knockout only.
falsifier: MYC occupancy at early-neuron gene promoters equally lost in the SCAR12-class line, or retained in knockout cells when sorted for the same cell-cycle stratum and MYC protein level; or occupancy lost in the knockout and equally reduced in a MYC-high wild-type progenitor control (then loss follows progenitor state, not WWOX); or no occupancy difference once library depth and peak calling are matched.
transfer_limit: one study (PMID 42397075), human organoid-derived neural stem cells for the ChIP; the occupancy datum is an auditor's visual reading of one figure with supplements not held, not a receipt; the SCAR12-class occupancy is not stated in the sources read, so the contrast is a proposal, not an observation; loss of binding can follow a closed chromatin state rather than precede it; no direction is carried to a compound, no lever follows from it, and nothing here changes INV-17, the MYC need or its direction (uncertain). Not medical advice.
